summary: Requested a fresh execution of a revised store-failure probe that adds the other request shape a leader sends to a peer whose nextIndex still points past the deleted suffix: after the existing baseline, conflicting and whole-log phases it sends a single entry 4 at term 2 with previous index 3, and logs the response, the in-memory last index, the store's last index and whether indices 2 and 4 are stored, for both the injected-failure case and the no-failure control. The revision is submitted with the earlier experiment as previous_id and its reason, since only the whole-log shape had been measured; the harness compiled and ran locally for construction only, so no result is claimed. Validation returned valid with execution_requested true; the interpretation of the receipt is the incomplete work, together with the live-leader retry walk and the vote consequence.
